# ShipLabel

USPS shipping labels from inside Muse. Describe the sender, recipient, and parcel — Muse drafts the label, shows you the carrier rate, and you pay postage plus a $1.99 service fee before EasyPost issues the label. USPS only. Created by Telep IO; labels and billing run through their service at muse.telep.io.
